title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the enforcement of the Digital Markets Act
part_text: Expresses concern over political pressure from third countries urging the EU to reconsider or weaken the DMA, and underlines that such external interference must not compromise the EU’s sovereignty and its autonomy to define and enforce its own rules; stresses that DMA obligations apply equally to all designated gatekeepers providing services in the EU, irrespective of their place of establishment or nationality;
